Distribution and habitat: — Biarum persicum is a local endemic, restricted to the Iran, an element of the Irano-Turanian phytogeographical region. Usually this species lives at altitudes of 2300 – 2500 m in stony steppe lands. Around 100 mature individuals growing in one population were found in stony steppe areas (Fig. 1). Associated species were Taraxacum syriacum Boissier (1856: 2 – 3), Ceratocarpus arenarius Linnaeus (1753: 2), Astragalus brachycalyx Fischer (1843: 363), Eryngium heldreichii Boissier (1849: 1, 10) and Gundelia tournefortii Linnaeus (1753: 2).
